_comment: Hand-curated pixel positions for warps whose raw data lacks world coords (e.g. rail-system warps with worldX/Y/Z = null). Two shapes: (a) `<eventIndex>: [pixelX, pixelY]` — reposition an existing raw warp; (b) `_extraWarps: [{destinationMapId, pixelX, pixelY, label?, faceDirection?}]` — inject synthetic warps that don't exist in the raw event data (used to patch asymmetric warp gaps from the ROM extract). The generator applies positions AFTER worldToPixel.

214._comment: Victory Road outer view. 19 rail warps + 1 synthetic Pokémon League warp (zone 136). Arch positions detected by PNG scan, then paired to warp eventIndex by matching the user's hand-labeled destination IDs on each visible arch (228, 226, 226, 225, 227, 224, 218, 222, 223, 217, 221, 216, 219, 220, 215, 364). 16 of 19 raw warps placed; the remaining 3 (event indexes 10, 11, 17 — overworld exit + redundant 226 hub links) have no visible arch and stay in the off-map sidebar. The Pokémon League warp is synthetic because the raw event data has 136→214 but not the reverse.
